answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the island of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nectar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing.
